body:
Being on a hiatus from weed due to a deal with my parents, I've been in sort of a 'chasing the dragon' mode for a year or two.  It started when I broke my wrist and got a Percocet and Vicodin prescription.
When I came across some Vicodin about a year later, I forgot how much I missed it.  When I ran out, I'd tell doctors that I had back pain hoping they'd take pity on me.  Sadly, it was harder than I thought to get.  One of my doctors gave me some Methocarbamol, a muscle relaxer, as a substitute.  I took 1 or 2 from time to time for a few weeks with little effect.
One day at work I decided to chill out and take 3 Methocarbamols.
11:30 AM - I take the 3 pills.
12:00 PM - I start to feel dizzy and unknowingly black out.  30 minutes later my officemate wakes me up saying I was making strange sounds that sounded like snoring.  I feel sick and throw up.  After my friend helps me down to the nurse, she advises I go to the ER.  I'm sweating profusely and can't see straight.
1:15 PM - I'm in the ambulance but starting to feel better.  I drink some water and tell the medics Im an idiot.
2:00 PM  After talking with a few doctors, Im ready to go home.
Please, be careful before taking this medication.  Overdosing was quite uncomfortable and embarrassing.  Never touching that shit again.  Ill stick to Vicodin.
[Reported Dose: ''3 750 mg Methocarbamol, 2 kratom capsules, 5 mg Adderall XR'']
